name: one-arm-dumbbell-upright-row.html
instructions:
1. Choose a dumbbell and stand with your feet around shoulder width apart.
2. Grasp the dumbbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down) with your left hand and place it on your thigh.
3. Your left hand should be just inside shoulder width and there should be a slight bend in your elbow.
4. Lift the dumbbell straight up while keeping it as close to your body as possible. You should pull the dumbbell up to around chest height - nearly touching your chin.
5. Pause, and then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for desired reps and then repeat with your right arm.
